mapper.select: SELECT SEQCATEGORY AS seqCategory, CATEGORYNAME AS categoryName, SORTORDER AS sortOrder, USEYN AS useYn FROM BOARD_CATEGORY WHERE USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORTORDER ASC, SEQCATEGORY ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQBOARDPOST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BOARD_POST ( SEQBOARDPOST, SEQCATEGORY, SEQMEMBER, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEWCOUNT, STATUS, CREATEDATE, THUMBNAILURL ) VALUES ( #{seqBoardPost}, #{seqCategory}, #{seqMember}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 'NORMAL', SYSDATE, #{thumbnailUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO BOARD_POST_FILE ( SEQBOARDPOSTFILE, SEQBOARDPOST, ORIGINALNAME, SAVEDNAME, FILEPATH, FILESIZE, FILETYPE, CREATEDATE ) VALUES ( SEQBOARDPOSTFILE.NEXTVAL, #{seqBoardPost}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT bp.SEQBOARDPOST AS seqBoardPost, bp.SEQCATEGORY AS seqCategory, bp.SEQMEMBER AS seqMember, bp.TITLE AS title, bp.CONTENT AS content, bp.VIEWCOUNT AS viewCount, bp.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(bp.CREATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate, TO_CHAR(bp.UPDATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updateDate, bc.CATEGORYNAME AS categoryName, m.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, m.NAME AS writerName FROM BOARD_POST bp INNER JOIN BOARD_CATEGORY bc ON bp.SEQCATEGORY = bc.SEQCATEGORY INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON bp.SEQMEMBER = m.SEQMEMBER WHERE bp.SEQBOARDPOST = #{seqBoardPost} AND bp.STATUS = 'NORMAL'

SELECT SEQBOARDPOSTFILE AS seqBoardPostFile, SEQBOARDPOST AS seqBoardPost, ORIGINALNAME AS originalName, SAVEDNAME AS savedName, FILESIZE AS fileSize, FILETYPE AS fileType, TO_CHAR(CREATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate FROM BOARD_POST_FILE WHERE SEQBOARDPOST = #{seqBoardPost} ORDER BY SEQBOARDPOSTFILE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_POST SET SEQCATEGORY = #{seqCategory}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATEDATE = SYSDATE, THUMBNAILURL = #{thumbnailUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE SEQBOARDPOST = #{seqBoardPost}
UPDATE BOARD_POST SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATEDATE = SYSDATE WHERE SEQBOARDPOST = #{seqBoardPost}
